# ETeams STE partition table - ESP32-S3: # OTA is deliberately gone (spec v0.1 section 2): firmware is loaded over USB
# so there is a single `factory` app partition and no otadata. That removes the
# 3 MB ota_1 slot and the whole rollback surface.
# There is no `vfs` FAT partition either: TLS cert/key are embedded in the
# application image at build time (see main/CMakeLists.txt EMBED_TXTFILES)
# nothing has to be flashed at a second offset and there is no wear-levelling
# CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET stays 0xC000 so the bootloader (mbedTLS TLS 1.3

~0x9000 long) still fits below the table.
